12:48.race_name: Win £250,000 With BetMGM's Golden Goals Novice Stakes

runners.comment: Has ability but this won't be easy conceding 12lb to the two fillies after another absence
runners.name: Elements Of Fire
runners.spotlight: Narrow winner on Chelmsford debut (7f, Polytrack) in November 2024 and fourth of 12 in a Doncaster novice (7f, good to firm) last April; has since left the Gosdens for 32,000gns and been gelded; clearly has ability, but this won't be easy conceding 12lb to the two fillies after another lengthy absence.

runners.comment: Beaten half a length by a subsequent winner on debut here last month; improvement likely
runners.name: Freda
runners.spotlight: Sent off 33-1 when beaten half a length on her belated debut over 1m here last month, running green and not enjoying a clear run (winner has since followed up in a handicap back here); improvement likely and respected.

runners.comment: Beaten two necks on her Redcar debut in September; could well improve this year
runners.name: Holly Mist
runners.spotlight: 9-2 when beaten two necks into third of seven on her Redcar debut (7f, good to soft) in September; the form is ordinary, but she could well improve this year.

runners.comment: Solid at 6f since Wolverhampton win in December; 7f winner in 2024 but mixed at trip since
runners.name: Profit Street
runners.spotlight: Solid operator over 6f here and on Tapeta since winning at Wolverhampton in December; seemingly weighted to his best now and although he did win over 7f at Newcastle in 2024 he's been less convincing in a handful of recent attempts at the trip.

runners.comment: 7f winner at Chelmsford in November; solid 4th over C&D for new yard; held at 1m since
runners.name: Tam Lin
runners.spotlight: Often leads, as when winning at Chelmsford (7f) in November; solid start for new yard when a close fourth of nine over C&D last month but he didn't achieve much over 1m back at Chelmsford (had won over that trip on turf in Ireland last year) since; not dismissed on the earlier run.

runners.comment: C&D winner; mostly low key these days but better than bare result here in December
runners.name: Global Warning
runners.spotlight: Six AW wins, latest over C&D in 2024; mostly found life rather hard work in 2025 and he didn't find much when favourite over C&D recently; however, an earlier run here in December suggests he might well be involved.

runners.comment: Course wins at 1m4f/1m; outpaced early when fast-finishing 2nd over C&D on sole 7f start
runners.name: Semser
runners.spotlight: Two course wins, at 1m4f and 1m; has raced only once at 7f, over C&D in August (favourite), and although a fast-finishing runner-up, the early stages weren't too encouraging as he was taken off his legs; if sharper in the early stages he'd look interesting.

runners.comment: Two AW wins in early 2025 included one over 7f, both for R Ryan; well treated now
runners.name: Rumba Bay
runners.spotlight: Two AW wins in early 2025, over 7f at Chelmsford and 6f at Wolverhampton, both under Rossa Ryan; her form took a turn for the worse, including for him, in the second half of the year but she didn't do badly in a slowly run C&D race won by Ashford Hill last time and Ryan returns to the saddle.

runners.comment: Both wins over C&D came after a break, the latest 17 days ago; not sure to be as good here
runners.name: Ashford Hill
runners.spotlight: Goes well fresh, popping up over C&D on yard debut in 2024 and again, following a four-month break, back here 17 days ago, both for regular rider Isobelle Chalmers; however, she has more to prove on her course runs in between the wins so she's no good thing to repeat her latest form.

runners.comment: All five wins at sprint trips on turf; 0-15 on AW; lacklustre finish back at 7f last month
runners.name: World Of Darcy
runners.spotlight: All five wins at sprint trips on turf; 0-15 on AW and his finish was lacklustre when returned to 7f at Southwell last month; up against it.

runners.comment: Modest so far, failing to beat a rival in two handicap runs, at 6f and 1m; now tongue tied
runners.name: Emperors Logic
runners.spotlight: Modest form so far, failing to beat a rival in two handicaps, at 6f and 1m; needs so much more for the fitting of a tongue-tie.

13:48.race_name: Midnite, Building The Future Of Betting Handicap

runners.comment: Running with great credit since 5f Newcastle win in November; can go close again
runners.name: Fidelius
runners.spotlight: Things haven't gone his way since making all over 5f at Newcastle in November but he's still run with great credit from off the pace in competitive races, including over C&D; back up 1lb for latest run; can go close.

runners.comment: Never better, narrow 5f win at Southwell then fast-finishing 3rd over C&D; tongue-tie off
runners.name: Star Chorus
runners.spotlight: Never better than of late, just coming out best in a tight scrap at Southwell (5f) and slightly hampered when unable to get to the winner in time over C&D since, when finishing a close third; big player if leaving off the tongue-tie makes no difference.

runners.comment: Useful C&D form on reappearance last year; three 5f wins on Polytrack/turf since
runners.name: Nogos Dream
runners.spotlight: Had some useful form in 5f handicaps in 2025 and he wasn't as well positioned as the winner (who won his next two) when a strong-finishing runner-up on reappearance over C&D last January; three wins for high-profile riders since and the booking of Billy Loughnane looks significant; usually wears cheekpieces but not today (ran well without on comeback in 2024).

runners.comment: Two C&D wins; in good form since November success but work to do for win purposes
runners.name: Diomed Spirit
runners.spotlight: Two C&D wins; in good form since the latest of them in November but there were no obvious excuses here ten days ago, under Rossa Ryan, and has work to do to turn things round with the third Star Chorus.

runners.comment: Late dash last month took her record to 3 wins from last 4 C&D starts; not fully exposed
runners.name: Toolatetonegotiate
runners.spotlight: In tremendous form here in recent months and a sustained dash from off the pace in January gained her a third win from her last four C&D runs; raised a further 2lb but she's ready for this better race.

14:18.race_name: Read Meg Nicholls' Blog At betmgm.co.uk Classified Stakes (Div I)

runners.comment: Won a division of this last year but not particularly solid on subsequent form
runners.name: Conquest Of Power
runners.spotlight: Won a division of this race 12 months ago and followed up at Newcastle; not particularly solid on subsequent form.

runners.comment: Remains capable of picking up prize-money but losing sequence continues to grow
runners.name: Eye Of The Water
runners.spotlight: Remains capable of picking up occasional prize-money and hit the frame plenty of times last year; however, his losing sequence continues to grow.

runners.comment: Got first run and stuck on well to win an 8.6f classified at Wolverhampton 11 days ago
runners.name: First Encounter
runners.spotlight: Got first run and stuck on well to win an 8.6f classified at Wolverhampton 11 days ago; that panned out favourably and he's drawn wide here, but still has less to prove than most.

runners.breeder: Mrs D Joly D Powell & A Richardson
runners.comment: Ran surprisingly well four days ago but she looked a tricky ride in the new blinkers
runners.name: Galette
runners.spotlight: 16-race maiden with a basement BHA mark of 37; ran surprisingly well when an 80-1 third in a 7f classified race four days but she looked a tricky ride in the new blinkers.

runners.comment: Come up well short in three visits here since going close at the track in September
runners.name: Rainbow Sign
runners.spotlight: Strike-rate of 3-60 so thoroughly exposed and has come up well short in three visits here since going close at the track in September; contested a classified race last time.

runners.comment: She's now 0-10 and has been beaten hefty distances in her last three races
runners.name: Rosemarys Rose
runners.spotlight: Has twice finished third but she's now 0-10 and has been beaten hefty distances in her last three races, the latest a classified.

runners.comment: Won at Wolverhampton for David O'Meara but 2-21 overall and these terms aren't favourable
runners.name: Senseofentitlement
runners.owner: Miss M P Bryant David & Eileen Bryant
runners.spotlight: Won at Wolverhampton for David O'Meara but 2-21 overall and these terms aren't favourable.

runners.comment: Had no excuses but ran okay to be third in a C&D handicap 12 days ago
runners.name: Unknown Journey
runners.spotlight: Had no excuses but ran okay to be third in a C&D handicap 12 days ago; that extended his losing run to 18, though.

14:48.race_name: Read Meg Nicholls' Blog At betmgm.co.uk Classified Stakes (Div II)

runners.comment: Hard to win with but closely matched with Tilsworth Max on their recent clash here
runners.name: Alyara
runners.owner: Lynn Cullimore Pete Ponting Joe Ponting
runners.spotlight: Hard to win with but closely matched with Tilsworth Max on their recent clash here (7f) when she finished the race off well; has won over this far.

runners.comment: Beaten 5l in a handicap last time and now tackles first classified race
runners.name: Angelica K
runners.spotlight: Won a 1m handicap at Kempton a year ago; beaten 5l in a handicap after three months off last time and now tackles first classified race; could feature.

runners.comment: Over a year since last successful and he needs to step up on recent efforts
runners.name: Headshot
runners.spotlight: Over a year since last successful and he needs to step up on recent efforts, including at this level.

runners.comment: Has lost her way and was only sixth of seven on yard debut at Chelmsford on Sunday
runners.name: Lisabetta
runners.spotlight: AW winner in Ireland; has lost her way and was only sixth of seven on yard debut at Chelmsford on Sunday (1m2f classified).

runners.comment: Signed off in America with uncompetitive runs and new trainer goes with new headgear
runners.name: Nicely Curved
runners.spotlight: Signed off in America with uncompetitive runs and new trainer goes with new headgear; hard to know what to expect.

runners.comment: Never figured in a 7f classified race here a month ago on return from a break
runners.name: Spirit Charmer
runners.spotlight: Never figured in a 7f classified race here a month ago on return from a break; that was won by Tilsworth Max; unfavoured by the weights.

runners.comment: Three good runs since the hood was removed, including 7f classified win here
runners.name: Tilsworth Max
runners.spotlight: Three good runs since the hood was removed, including 7f classified win here; returning to 1m shouldn't hurt.

runners.comment: Shocker last time but very capable of going close if back on song
runners.name: Wrist Art
runners.spotlight: Won twice in Ireland during 2023; in a new visor when close up in 9.4f/1m2f classified races but had a shocker last time and now goes in cheekpieces; very capable of going close if back on song.

15:18.race_name: Create Your Bet Builders At Midnite Handicap

runners.comment: Latest three AW wins over 6f/5f here last winter; weights chance; no visor again
runners.name: Coolagh Magic
runners.owner: Lady Emma Oshea And A Carson
runners.spotlight: Nine AW wins, the latest three over 6f and 5f here last winter (in tongue-tie/visor), but no aids for much of 2025; should come on for recent run, after a break and wind surgery (tongue-tie back on without visor); weights chance off reduced mark.

runners.comment: Multiple Polytrack wins; back to form of late with a win and second to in-form rival
runners.name: Sir Rodneyredblood
runners.spotlight: Sixteen AW wins, all bar one on Polytrack; wasn't on his game late in 2025 but back to form with a wide-margin win at Chelmsford (6f) last month and there wasn't much he could do about one on a three-timer there (5f) three days later; up 2lb; drawn widest.

runners.comment: Multiple winner at both sprint trips, the latest before Christmas; gone quiet since
runners.name: Alafdhal
runners.spotlight: All wins at 6f up to two years ago but last five successes at 5f, most recently off much the same mark at Wolverhampton before Christmas; has beaten a total of two rivals in his last three starts, however, so more needs to be done back at 6f; cheekpieces refitted in place of a visor.

runners.comment: Lightly raced maiden; two good 6f AW runs this year; should go well again
runners.name: Dark Sun
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced maiden who was thereabouts in 7f turf handicaps last year; not bothered by the return to 6f on AW this year, hampered on the first occasion, then came home strongly for a close second over C&D last month; should go well.

runners.comment: All three wins over 5f on turf; running well on AW but inconclusive form on rare 6f runs
runners.name: Son Of Astar
runners.spotlight: All three wins over 5f on turf but recent AW form, despite being a beaten favourite on last three starts, puts him in the picture; however, he rarely tackles 6f and when he has, his form has been inconclusive.

runners.comment: Four C&D wins; on last winning mark in October and has had some excuses since
runners.name: Harry Brown
runners.owner: Peter Crate And Gallagher Bloodstock Ltd
runners.spotlight: Four of five AW wins have come over C&D, the latest quite readily in October off today's mark; has had some excuses since and may well show his best side this time.

runners.comment: Added two wins in 2025, over 6f and a dead-heat off this mark over 7f; back to form latest
runners.name: Nubough
runners.spotlight: Two C&D wins; has been racing over 7f, a rival forcing a dead-heat off this mark at Chelmsford last May, but he had won over 6f there last March; finished a fair runner-up when making the running again here last month but likely more needed for the win.

runners.comment: Both wins over 7f in 2022; fair mark on second run after absence but may need another run
runners.name: Dayman
runners.spotlight: Both wins over 7f on AW in 2022; not entirely forlorn off current mark on his best 2024 form but he was soundly beaten on his return from an absence last month and has a tricky draw now back at 6f.

runners.comment: All races at 5f, winning turf novice as 2yo; nearly took advantage of weights drop latest
runners.name: Desdemona
runners.spotlight: All races at 5f, sole win in a turf novice here as a 2yo; went handicapping off a high mark after but she's a lot better treated now and only just failed here last month; now needs to show she can do it at 6f.

runners.comment: 0-11 on AW but two good 5f runs this winter, including latest; trip query back at 6f
runners.name: Spendmore Lane
runners.spotlight: 0-11 on AW but has shown enough over 5f, including at Wolverhampton (first-time eyeshield, retained) recently to suggest she won't be a maiden for long; unlucky with the draw today though and ultimately onepaced in one previous 6f handicap on Polytrack.

runners.comment: Not badly treated but in better form in December than of late; S Donohoe 1-1 on him
runners.name: Roman Emperor
runners.spotlight: Sole AW win was a 6f novice two years ago; in better form in December than he is now but Stevie Donohoe is 1-1 on him (on turf last summer) so there might be a turnaround.

runners.comment: Multiple AW wins; mostly out of sorts in 2025 but brought up the hat-trick last night
runners.name: Beauzon
runners.spotlight: Multiple AW wins include two over C&D; more modest runs than good ones in 2025 but he's been back on song with two 6f classified wins this year before making all in clearcut style at Wolverhampton last night; strong contender under small penalty.

15:48.race_name: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.comment: Still unexposed, but she has an awkward draw on this return from 74 days off
runners.name: Kate ORiley
runners.spotlight: Dual Wolverhampton winner (8.6f/1m4f) for Michael Bell last winter and was successful over hurdles for this yard in October; still unexposed, but she has an awkward draw on this return from 74 days off.

runners.comment: Has been well held in both starts since returning last month; cheekpieces on
runners.name: Cristo
runners.spotlight: Dual winner at Chelmsford (1m2f, Polytrack) last spring, but has been well held in both starts since returning last month having been gelded in the meantime; cheekpieces will need to make a difference.

runners.comment: Record in AW handicaps since last June reads 51121511; up another 8lb but still considered
runners.name: Wyld Bill
runners.spotlight: Record in AW handicaps since last June reads 51121511 including an emphatic win over C&D; off since winning by a nose at Kempton (1m3f, Polytrack) in December and now 8lb higher, but still hard to leave him out of calculations.

runners.comment: Middle leg of his hat-trick early last year included this race off 3lb lower; interesting
runners.name: Arcadian Nights
runners.spotlight: Best known as a Wolverhampton specialist (six wins), but is 2-5 over C&D and the middle leg of his hat-trick early last year included this race off 3lb lower; interesting.

runners.comment: 1-16 in France; makes his stable debut after four months off; market useful
runners.name: Good Speed
runners.spotlight: Just 1-16 in France but placed in all three starts on AW surfaces; makes his stable debut after four months off (gelded since last seen) having been picked up for 62,000euros in November; market useful; stable also runs Canopus.

runners.comment: Not as good as he was but finished a close third at Wolverhampton last time; could go well
runners.name: Epictetus
runners.spotlight: Listed/Group 3 winner for the Gosdens; nowhere near as good these days, but was beaten less than a length into third of nine at Wolverhampton (8.6f, Tapeta) last time; stays this far and could go well.

runners.comment: 1-12; makes his stable debut after 251 days off; hood on; market informative
runners.name: Metallo
runners.spotlight: 1-12 for Jack Channon; fairly treated on his AW form from last winter, but makes his debut for his new yard (same owners) in a first-time hood after 251 days off; market informative.

runners.comment: Exclusively campaigned over 1m these days and is on a losing run of 23
runners.name: Plantadream
runners.owner: H J Jarvis & Mrs P Jarvis
runners.spotlight: Veteran who finished runner-up in his only previous go over C&D, but that was in 2020; exclusively campaigned over 1m these days and is on a losing run of 23, so has enough to prove.

runners.comment: Three modest efforts since returning in December; still has stamina to prove; eyeshield on
runners.name: Bravo Zulu
runners.spotlight: Enjoyed a fine time of it between December 2024 and last July win six wins from 7f-8.6f, including two here; three modest efforts since returning in December and hasn't shone in his few attempts over this far; eyeshield is given a go.

runners.comment: Wolverhampton winner for Marco Botti; stable debut after ten months off; watch market
runners.name: Perfect Life
runners.spotlight: Early promise for Marco Botti, winning a Wolverhampton maiden (8.6f, Tapeta) in December 2024, but well beaten on handicap/turf debut at Sandown (1m2f, good) last April; makes stable debut (same owner) after ten months off; market should be revealing.

runners.comment: Plenty to prove on return from six months off and has the outside stall
runners.name: Qitaal
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent and has only managed to win one of his last 23 starts; plenty to prove on return from six months off and he has the outside stall.

runners.comment: Twice runner-up over 1m in September, but beaten a long way over hurdles on stable debut
runners.name: Canopus
runners.spotlight: Twice runner-up over 1m at Windsor (good) and Newcastle (Tapeta) for Ed Walker in September, but beaten a long way over hurdles on stable debut 15 days ago; something to prove.

16:18.race_name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap

runners.comment: Carries a 5lb penalty for her Wolverhampton success, but remains unexposed at the trip
runners.name: Take The Boat
runners.spotlight: Stamina proved no problem when successful on her fourth start for this yard in an amateurs' event at Wolverhampton (1m4f, Tapeta) eight days ago; carries a 5lb penalty, but remains unexposed at the trip and a player.

runners.comment: Out of the frame in four starts since back on the AW, but has dropped to a dangerous mark

runners.spotlight: Out of the frame in all four starts since returned to the AW, but his fifth of ten over 1m2f here in December suggested that all may not be lost; now 6lb lower than for that effort and 8lb lower than when last successful; interesting.

runners.comment: 0-8, but 3lb lower than when a close third at Kempton in August; worth a second look
runners.name: Seventy
runners.spotlight: 0-8, but 3lb lower than when a close third of 11 at Kempton (1m4f, Polytrack) in August when trained by Richard Hannon; not disgraced on second start for this yard at Wolverhampton (9.5f, Tapeta) last time and worth a second look.

runners.comment: Just 1-15 but no doubting her consistency having been placed eight times; should go well
runners.name: Three On Thursday
runners.spotlight: Just 1-15, the win coming over 1m2f here, but no doubting her consistency having been placed eight times; still 5lb higher than for her sole success, but she seems likely to go well again.

runners.comment: Off the mark at Wolverhampton in October, but held since; 1lb drop not enough to tempt
runners.name: Top Of Pleinmont
runners.spotlight: Made it tenth-time lucky at Wolverhampton (1m4f, Tapeta) in October, but held in two starts at Southwell (1m6f/1m3f) since; 1lb drop not enough to tempt.

runners.comment: 0-6 for three different stables, though has shown ability; still has stamina to prove
runners.name: Hawaiian King

runners.spotlight: 0-6 for three different stables, though has shown ability as when fourth of nine on his debut for this yard here (1m2f) 17 days ago; still has stamina to prove, though.

runners.comment: 8lb lower than when beating three rivals at Bath last May, but modest form when last seen
runners.name: Versatile
runners.spotlight: 1-19, the win coming when beating three rivals at Bath (1m2f, firm) last May; now 8lb lower, but his two efforts since returned to the AW in October leave something to be desired; off 103 days.

runners.comment: Well held in all six starts at up to 8.6f; makes little appeal
runners.name: Pacific Prince
runners.spotlight: Well held in all six starts at up to 8.6f; sire offers hope as far as the longer trip is concerned, but he still makes little appeal.

runners.comment: Won twice last month and latest effort over 1m2f here on Saturday can be excused

runners.comment: Three-time C&D winner and second in November, but he doesn't have a great record fresh
runners.name: Pablo Prince
runners.spotlight: Three-time C&D winner who returned to form when second of 13 at Chelmsford (13.3f, Polytrack) in November; 2lb rise still leaves him 1lb below his last winning mark, but he has been off 76 days and doesn't have a great record fresh.

runners.breeder: G Hedley & Mike Channon Bloodstock Ltd

runners.name: Gearings Point
runners.spotlight: C&D winner who enjoyed a productive 2023; losing run up to 17, but the return to this trip may suit and she could go well at a price.

runners.comment: Little to get excited about in five starts; best watched for now
runners.name: High Favour
runners.spotlight: Little to get excited about in five starts including two on Polytrack for this yard since returning from a mammoth absence; best watched for now.

runners.comment: Two wins for Fergal O'Brien last term but has proved rather disappointing for her new yard

runners.comment: Point winner; 12l second to progressive sort over 2m1f latest; interesting on that run
runners.name: The Coffey Boy
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner last February; best run over hurdles when 12l second to a progressive subsequent winner over 2m1f at Sedgefield last time (good to soft); interesting on that run.

runners.comment: 1-23; well behind So Many Roads over C&D last time; plenty to find on that form
runners.name: Lewa House
runners.spotlight: Strike-rate of 1-23; well behind So Many Roads over C&D last time (soft); plenty to find on that form.

runners.comment: Pulled up in the C&D handicap won by So Many Roads last time; others have stronger claims
runners.name: Bray Dale

14:05.race_name: Watch On Racing TV Handicap Chase (Go North Monet's Garden Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Point winner; won 2m h'cap chase here last March; 2m4f no problem but yard not in top form
runners.name: Heads Or Harps
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner (3m); won a 2m handicap here last March (soft) and best run this term when runner-up over 2m here two runs back (heavy); return to this trip no problem but stable hasn't been in top form recently.

runners.comment: Two good ground wins this term; fair 3rd last time; track and trip suit; should go well
runners.name: Sleeping Satellite
runners.spotlight: Winner on good ground at Stratford (2m3f) and Catterick (2m3f) this season; not disgraced when third of four at Musselburgh last time (2m4f, soft; jumped left on occasions); return to a left-handed track should suit and could go well (won a bumper on soft ground).

runners.name: Lauras Breeze
runners.spotlight: Runner-up twice in this grade here (6f/7f) last February/March but returned from break with two down-the-field handicap runs in the autumn and has been off for another three months since; refused to enters stalls latest intended start.

runners.comment: 20-race maiden; sports first-time eyeshield for first run in this basement grade
runners.name: Mister McGregor
runners.spotlight: Yet to be placed after seven starts for current stable and overall strike-rate is now 0-20; sports first-time eyeshield for first run in this basement grade.

runners.comment: Latest win was nearly two years ago and recent efforts have been disappointing
runners.name: Nazca
runners.spotlight: Gained three of his six wins over C&D but the latest was nearly two years ago, and his recent efforts have been very disappointing.

runners.comment: Twice in the frame off her basement handicap mark here in the autumn; others look stronger
runners.name: Shesashambles
runners.spotlight: Won in this grade on turf in summer 2024 but is 0-26 on AW; made the frame twice off her basement handicap over C&D in the autumn and didn't run badly when seventh in this grade here last month but others look stronger.

runners.comment: Second in this grade over 1m here on Wednesday; should cope with this drop back in trip
runners.name: Sir Maxi
runners.spotlight: Regressive 8yo who has been campaigned over longer trips since the summer, most recently when second over 1m in this grade here on Wednesday; should cope with this drop back to 6f, though, and enters calculations.

runners.comment: Arrested decline with respectable C&D handicap fourth lsst month; cheekpieces refitted
runners.name: The Gay Blade
runners.spotlight: On a losing streak but arrested his decline with respectable C&D handicap fourth three weeks ago and has possibilities today if the refitted cheekpieces help him to build on that performance.

runners.comment: Ran okay in C&D handicap last month and could be dangerous in this grade
runners.name: Tickets
runners.spotlight: Generally disappointing since returning from a break in the autumn but certainly didn't run badly when sixth (just behind Auntie Jo) in C&D handicap three weeks ago and could be dangerous in this grade.

runners.comment: Made the frame over C&D on three of last four appearances; each-way claims again
runners.name: Yaahobby
runners.spotlight: Without a win since October 2024 but made the frame over C&D off his basement handicap mark on three of his last four appearances and has each-way claims again in this classified race.

runners.comment: Denied clear run before going close at Southwell in December and remains on good mark
runners.name: Dc Cogent
runners.owner: J R Dwyer And B Smart
runners.spotlight: Made no significant further progress after winning 5f course maiden last March but was denied a clear run before keeping on well to go close at Southwell (6f) in December and remains well handicapped after 1lb nudge.

runners.comment: C&D winner in December but has questions to answer after two down-the-field runs
runners.name: Judgment Call
runners.owner: Paul Corrigan & Miss L A Perratt
runners.spotlight: 1-17 on AW, the win gained over C&D off 1lb lower in December; placed over 7f since but has questions to answer after two down-the-field runs, the latter here (7f) on Friday.

runners.comment: Ran quite well last month and is now on same mark as for game win in this race in 2025
runners.name: Blackjack
runners.spotlight: Ran quite well from the front when fourth behind Showtime Mahomes in refitted visor at Southwell last month and is now back on same mark as when digging deep to win this race in first-time visor a year ago; others appeal more all the same, though.

runners.comment: Still on workable mark after last month's Southwell win but has mixed record lately
runners.name: Showtime Mahomes
runners.spotlight: Came from off the pace to score at Southwell last month, his seventh success; probably still on a workable mark but his latest run was below par and his record in recent months is very mixed.

runners.comment: Placed off much reduced mark at Wolverhampton last month and now another 1lb lower
runners.name: Phoenix Of Dreams
runners.spotlight: Generally disappointing since last season's pleasing reappearance run but was placed off much reduced mark at Wolverhampton (6f) last month and is another 1lb lower; could have a say.

runners.comment: Often loses ground at the start and has not fired on any of three starts since a break
runners.name: Brian The Snail
runners.spotlight: Old-timer with 14 wins (two over C&D) on his CV; often loses ground at the start and has not really fired on any of three starts since December, when he returned from a break; others look safer.

runners.comment: Close second to progressive rival on recent stable debut at Southwell; big player
runners.name: Northern Attitude
runners.spotlight: 0-11 but was placed on consecutive C&D starts for Gemmy Tutty in the autumn and again ran well when close second to progressive rival on stable debut at Southwell (6f) 11 days ago; big player if that recent outing brought her on.

runners.comment: Fourth over C&D on last time starts; can threaten from off the pace if race is run to suit
runners.name: Captain Vallo
runners.spotlight: Three-time C&D winner; returned from break with low-key run in December but kept on for fourth over C&D on both subsequent appearances, and can pose a threat from off the pace if this race is run to suit.

runners.comment: Three C&D wins last month; close second off today's mark here on Wednesday; up in grade
runners.name: Spartan Fighter
runners.owner: John And Tony Jarvis And Partner
runners.spotlight: Sprightly 9yo who completed a quick hat-trick of front-running C&D wins last month and lost out only by a neck off today's mark here on Wednesday; upped in grade but likely to give another good account.

19:45.race_name: Daily Profit Boosts At betmgm.co.uk Apprentice Classified Stakes

runners.comment: Enjoyed run of the race when winning slowly run 7f classified here last month
runners.name: Chriss Mate
runners.spotlight: Came good at 13th attempt, with 7f course win in this grade three weeks ago; enjoyed run of the race in that slowly run event and his overall profile remains unconvincing but he should be fine back at 1m.

runners.comment: Fair fourth over 7f last month; latest run best ignored; yet to convince over 1m
runners.name: Dequinto
runners.spotlight: Made the frame off basement handicap mark at Southwell (7f) last month and recent defeat over that trip at Wolverhampton is best overlooked, given he was lit up by the first-time blinkers (now removed) and had far too much use made of him; yet to fully convince over 1m, though.

runners.comment: Sound effort when placed in 7f handicap here last month; big player back at 1m
runners.name: Esque Elegance
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish maiden who has made the frame on the last two of her four stable starts, more recently when third in 7f handicap here last month; ought to be suited by this return to 1m; big player, provided removal of usual cheekpieces doesn't backfire.

runners.comment: Mucked about in closing stages when placed in this grade at Wolverhampton recently
runners.name: Lady Delila
runners.spotlight: Still a maiden after 15 runs but hasn't been with Iain Jardine long and suffered some interference in closing stages when third in this grade at Wolverhampton (8.6f) 11 days ago; must be considered.

runners.comment: Ran quite well in October, after a break, but not in the same form again since
runners.name: Masham Moor
runners.spotlight: Kept on for fourth in 1m Southwell handicap in October, after a break, but this 9yo was not in the same form on any of his three subsequent appearances there; cheekpieces removed after one use.

runners.comment: Struggled in two bumpers and three AW novice races; makes very limited appeal
runners.name: Miss Helena
runners.spotlight: Struggled in two bumpers (wore eyeshields) in the autumn and three subsequent AW novice races (7f-9.4f; no headgear); has more realistic chance to get competitive in this basement grade but still makes very limited appeal; sports refitted eyeshields and first-time blinkers.

runners.comment: Unplaced all six starts; needs a good boost from the new cheekpieces
runners.name: Platinum Babe
runners.spotlight: Made low-key return from six-month break when eighth of ten in this grade at Wolverhampton (8.6f) last month and has now been unplaced all six starts; entitled to have benefited from that outing but still needs a good boost from the new cheekpieces.
